name: @ludengke95/smart-bookmark-mcp
description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) bridge server for the Smart Bookmark Chrome extension. Exposes your bookmarks/groups/tags to AI clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, WorkBuddy, Windsurf) over Stdio + a WebSocket proxy. Built on `ws` and the official `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`.
author: ludengke95 <ludengke95@gmail.com>
